title: Invalid State Admissions Benchmark: admission cases and disposition scorer
description: Ten synthetic admission cases and a disposition-only scorer published with the Tinor Journal research note 'Toward Zero Invalid State Admissions: A Benchmark Proposal'. The scorer compares declared outcomes and reasons only and reports CDR and disposition-level ISAR and VSAR, including for the always-reject, always-hold and always-admit baselines. A proposal: no results are reported for any system.
